brief:
Ireland will host Israel for two football matches despite mounting calls from Irish activists and political figures for a boycott linked to the war in Gaza, Al Jazeera English reported. The fixtures are proceeding as scheduled despite growing domestic pressure to cancel them on grounds related to the humanitarian crisis.

The controversy reflects broader tension over how sporting events should respond to geopolitical conflicts. Irish civil society groups have campaigned against the matches, framing them as a test of whether international sports bodies will take positions on major humanitarian crises.
dek: Ireland and Israel will play two football matches despite growing Irish calls for a boycott due to the genocide in Gaza.
title: Ireland-Israel football matches proceed amid Gaza boycott calls
